detail.longDescription:
When I remove an item that I believe my program no longer needs, the compiler will list, in its error messages, everywhere that item is still referred to. If I missed any, the compiler will find them and tell me exactly where they all are.

My IDE contains a modified compiler and can therefore also do the same thing.

THIS RIGHT HERE is one of the many reasons why my requirements for #programming languages include “strong static typing or GTFO.”
